description: Canonical schema for salmon-run plan files. Routing headers are current-state metadata. PondLog entries are the append-only history of actions performed on a plan.

Status.description: Current pond status. Updated on every transition.

Scope.description: One-line description of the plan's responsibility.

Challenge.description: Model tier or override for routing (Flash, Daily, Complex, Frontier, Local).

DependsOn.description: Comma-separated list of plan IDs that must reach Complete before this plan enters Code.

Children.description: Comma-separated list of child plan IDs for Project pond decomposition.

ProjectId.description: Parent project plan ID, if this plan is a child of a Project.

claim.description: An agent or operator claimed the plan for work.

prepare.description: The plan was prepared for execution (lane/stream selected, model routed).

lock.description: An exclusive lock was acquired on the plan for an execution attempt.

route.description: A model/profile was selected for the plan.

spawn.description: An executor process was started for the plan.

implement.description: The Code pond produced an implementation.

review.description: The Review pond reviewed the implementation.

audit.description: The Audit pond audited the plan for public-safety issues.

qa.description: The QA pond verified quality gates.

external-complete.description: An external agent executor completed a plan.

external-fail.description: An external agent executor failed to complete a plan.

fail.description: The plan moved to Failed (final failure).

retry.description: The plan was retried and moved back to an earlier pond.

override.description: A routing or execution value was overridden (preserved as history, not just current state).
